lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Estimate 9,150 − 4,780 and say whether an exact answer of 5,370 is reasonable.

FEEDBACK
About 9,000 − 5,000 = 4,000 (or 9,200 − 4,800 = 4,400); 5,370 may be plausible depending on rounding — compare to a closer estimate ~4,370.

WATCH FOR
An estimate that uses the wrong place (rounding to tens for five-digit numbers) is too fussy or too loose for a useful check.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
For twelve calculations, write an estimate, compute exactly and mark estimate close/far with a one-line reason.

Write a short reflection naming one step you corrected and why.

lesson.parent_notes:
Parent: Marking guidance for the independent task: For twelve calculations, write an estimate, compute exactly and mark estimate close/far with a one-line reason. Accept equivalent original responses that show the same skill.

Parent: Written model 1: Sample: new numbers solved with visible working for estimate; key places/values named. Do not award marks for retyping the model.

Parent: Written model 2: Sample misconception: An estimate that uses the wrong place (rounding to tens for five-digit numbers) is too fussy or too loose for a useful. Correction uses About 9,000 − 5,000 = 4,000 (or 9,200 − 4,800 = 4,400);. Why: restores accurate estimate.

Parent: Likely misconception: An estimate that uses the wrong place (rounding to tens for five-digit numbers) is too fussy or too loose for a useful check. Keep sample answers out of the child role.

Parent: Short-answer focus 1: Solve one fresh problem that uses estimate with different numbers from the worked model. Show working and name the places or values that matter.

Parent: Short-answer focus 2: Describe one likely mistake with estimate, show corrected working, and say why the correction works.

Parent: Marking notes: Accept any mathematically valid solution that uses new numbers, shows working for estimate, and names places/values. Reject copied model numbers. / Accept a named misconception about estimate, corrected working, and a method reason. Reject vague “I was wrong” with no repair..

teach_steps.explain:
Estimating sums and differences before written work catches place-value and regrouping errors early.

WHY IT MATTERS
This helps the learner choose methods based on place value, quantity and accurate working, rather than guessing digits by shape alone. Keep every step justified.

HOW TO WORK
Read the worked example and name the places, values or distances that carry the method. Before looking at the correction, make your own attempt using the exact question provided. Compare your working with the feedback: did you use the same skill and show your reasoning? If a digit or place is uncertain, identify what would have to be regrouped or counted again. One deliberate, justified revision is more useful than writing a longer answer.
teach_steps.notice: An estimate that uses the wrong place (rounding to tens for five-digit numbers) is too fussy or too loose for a useful check. Correct the value or method, not just the appearance of the digits.
